title: Prepare your PC. Prove the result. Restore with control.
summary: A technical journey for preparing a session, verifying what evidence supports, and preserving a path back.
body: Liiiraa Boost organizes preparation, proof, and restoration without promising gains before hardware is observed. Compatibility, validation, and distribution remain explicit.

metadata.title: Liiiraa Boost | Evidence-led performance and control
metadata.description: Explore the Liiiraa Boost approach to preparation, evidence, compatibility, and restoration.

warnings: Compatibility and results depend on hardware, Windows version, the game, and measurement quality.

actionableClaims: Check compatibility before considering any plan.
Review the source and boundary of every material claim.

hero.promise: Prepare your PC. Prove the result. Restore with control.
hero.summary: Enter the next session with a readable plan, identified evidence, and recovery treated as part of performance — never a footnote.

trustBoundary.title: What this capture proves
trustBoundary.body: The interface shown is a real, approved product capture. Its data and operations are deterministic scenarios; gains and compatibility depend on observed hardware.

chapters.title: Prepare with a plan you can review
chapters.summary: The desktop experience models recommendations, dependencies, risk, and consequence before any future native authority.
chapters.claim: The product presents preparation as an explicit review, not a generic unchecked action.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: This proves the implemented review experience; it does not prove a performance gain or privileged application.

chapters.title: Prove without turning a hypothesis into a result
chapters.summary: Source, validation state, version, and unavailability accompany what the interface presents as evidence.
chapters.claim: The interface distinguishes observed facts, simulated previews, and unavailable data with persistent provenance.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The evidence structure is validated; real per-machine measurements still depend on the future native engine.

chapters.title: Restore with the same rigor used to prepare
chapters.summary: History, consequence, and recovery are visible journey responsibilities, including when an action cannot proceed.
chapters.claim: The desktop experience includes deterministic history and restoration journeys with an explanation of the safe state.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The visual journey is implemented; real Windows restoration remains outside this phase's authority.

chapters.title: Compatibility is a decision, not a generic badge
chapters.summary: Windows 10 and 11 define the platform boundary. CPU, GPU, storage, network, and game profile still need to be observed.
chapters.claim: The public journey blocks universal conclusions and routes every visitor to a compatibility check.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The target platform is defined; support for a specific configuration is not claimed without validated inventory.

chapters.title: Control begins with decisions that can be audited
chapters.summary: The interface does not receive administrative power for convenience. Contracts, validation, and recovery bound every future operation.
chapters.claim: The product separates the unprivileged interface from future native operations and refuses arbitrary remote execution.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The architecture and boundaries are documented; secure native authority still needs implementation and verification.

chapters.title: A release counts only when the whole chain agrees
chapters.summary: Manifest, notes, compatibility, signature, and artifact must form a verifiable story before distribution.
chapters.claim: Public distribution remains blocked while no publicly trusted installer has been approved.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The current gate is verifiable; no release date, SmartScreen reputation, or future availability is promised.

finalJourney.title: Start with what your PC actually supports
finalJourney.body: The next step does not promise a result. It organizes the Windows and hardware context needed to say what is available, under validation, or unavailable.
